thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> LB target group TLS handshake failure rate > 60% for redwood-edge-prod (us-west-2). Auto-page to on-call.
pagerduty: Incident #PD-83421 created and paged to sre_oncall. Severity: P1.
alex.k: acked. I'm on it. seeing spike in TLS alerts from the ALB health checks.
maria_ops: I'm on chat ops. checking customer reports and support queue.
vince_net: pulling ALB metrics now. CloudWatch shows connection_error counts jump at 2026-03-14T03:20Z.
alex.k: curl to edge VIP shows TLS handshake failures intermittently:
```
$ curl -Iv https://edge.redwood.ai
* TLS handshake -> SSL_connect error
* Closing connection 0
```
alex.k: also seeing backend targets mark unhealthy in the target group (502/504). suspect cert or cipher mismatch or upstream kernel issue.
vince_net: running dig + trace to check recent DNS changes. suspect propagation after yesterday's cname swap.
```
$ dig +trace edge.redwood.ai
;; ->>HEADER<<- opcode: QUERY, status: NOERROR, id: 12345
;; Received 8 records from 198.51.100.1
... answers include new-alias-usw2.redwood.ai
```
vince_net: TTL for previous record was low (60s) but some resolvers still hit old nodes. mixing of old/new VIPs could cause TLS mismatch if certs differ.
sre_oncall: I'm going to mute noisy pager alerts for health checks (will keep high-level alerts). putting incident into "investigating".
alex.k: quick mitigation: adding temporary routing rule to prefer target-set B (known-good pool) and drain targets in target-set A.
```
# update LB weights
aws elbv2 modify-target-group-attributes --target-group-arn arn:... --attributes Key=routing.weight,Value=10
```
maria_ops: support_lead - can you draft an external message? we need to confirm if customers see 502s today.
support_lead: posting to status.redwood.ai: "Partial degraded performance for inference endpoints in us-west-2. Intermittent TLS/connectivity errors for a subset of requests. Engineers investigating." :loudspeaker:
alex.k: after shifting traffic, error rate fell from 62% -> 8% over 4 minutes. monitoring closely.
vince_net: I see earlier Terraform deployment touched ALB listener TLS policy yesterday (changed to policy-ELB-2) — rolling back listener policy to previous profile as a test.
```
# rollback listener TLS policy
aws elbv2 modify-listener --listener-arn arn:... --ssl-policy ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS-1-2-2017
```
sre_oncall: making change now, will coordinate with alex for traffic balancing.
alex.k: after rollback, TLS handshake errors dropped to ~1.2%, target health stabilized. Good indicator change introduced by policy swap.
vince_net: leaving both mitigations (route to B + rollback) active for now. will keep auto-retry window shorter and increase sampling.
maria_ops: support queue shows ~34 customer tickets since 03:18Z, mostly 502s. tagging impacted customers and adding "incident in progress" note.
support_lead: updating status page with incident timeline and expected next update in 15 minutes.
pagerduty: Incident PD-83421 acknowledged by alex.k at 2026-03-14T03:26Z.
alex.k: handing off to vince_net for follow-up and RCA drafts. I'll be offline for handoff at 03:40Z.
vince_net: taking over. current plan: keep rollback TLS policy, keep shifted traffic, run full certificate/cipher inventory across both pools, schedule follow-up deploy window to reintroduce policy with tests.
sre_oncall: starting post-incident checklist: capture graph snapshots, save ALB config, export CloudWatch metrics, collect healthcheck logs. please drop any commands/links here.
alex.k: dumps of healthcheck logs here:
```
/var/log/alb/healthcheck/2026-03-14.log
[03:20:12] target 10.0.5.12 TLS handshake failure: unexpected message
[03:20:14] target 10.0.5.15 Connection reset by peer
```
vince_net: creating RCA draft. initial summary: TLS policy change yesterday caused handshake incompatibility for some backend OS kernel + OpenSSL combos; DNS propagation mixed old/new VIPs exposing mismatch. impact: partial region degradation, some customers saw errors for short window.
support_lead: liaising with customers impacted by SLO guarantees; compiling list for outreach and credit review.
maria_ops: ETA for final status update in 30m. planning postmortem meeting tomorrow 14:00Z.
incident-bot: Incident PD-83421 status set -> mitigated (reduced error rate). will close after RCA and customer comms.
vince_net: final note before closing thread: will add automated pre-deploy validation for TLS policy changes and a canary rollout that probes multiple resolver chains to detect mixed-DNS scenarios. assigning follow-ups to infra team.
sre_oncall: thanks everyone. handoff complete. marking incident channel resolved and closing page. :white_check_mark:"
